MY STORY

From Code to Data

My journey started with Computer Science, where I learned how to solve problems and think logically.

As I explored different areas, I became more interested in data — understanding the story behind the numbers and turning them into meaningful insights.

That led me to Data Analysis, where I’ve been building my skills in SQL, Python, and Power BI through practical projects and professional training.

Today, I’m focused on growing as a Data Analyst and turning data into insights that are clear, useful, and easy to understand.
